posts.body_html: It's really hard for someone with zero education in photography to capture the true color of this clone, as seen in person... it's a bit darker than what is shown in the pics. I guess the only way to really tell that this clone is pretty dark is to compare a regular rubricorpora (ie. trap to the left) because the way the color comes out in the pics, it doesn't look as dark as it really is!
